create_parse_args: create a function that parses command-line arguments for the VideoPose3D training script
build_training_config: build a training configuration by specifying dataset, keypoints, subjects, and actions via CLI arguments
test_model_arguments: test the model argument parser with custom stride, epochs, batch size, dropout, and learning rate values
run_visualization: run video visualization with subject, action, camera, input video path, and output file path arguments
review_semi_supervised_flags: review the semi-supervised argument flags including subset, downsample, warmup, bone length term, and projection options
